tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (5.0:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: sage-primary
tokens.usage: Renewal, balance, natural healing. Used as text on `.nav-link.active`, `.footer-section a:hover`. 2.2:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: sage-deep
tokens.usage: Focus states, mindfulness depth. Used as text on `.logo`, `.nav-link:hover`, `.welcome-title`. 3.1:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: earth-brown
tokens.usage: Grounding, stability, organic connection. Used as text on `.logo-accent`, `.treatment-price`. 4.2:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Exceptional). Used as text on `body`, `td`. 8.4:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-label`, `.treatment-category`, `.footer-bottom`. 3.1:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: treatment-image-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `header`, `.treatment-image::after`, `.treatment-badge`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
